$comment: Audio pipeline config (docs/FX_AUDIO.md A0 / A1; scripts/audio/build-audio.js). Paths are relative to art/vendor/. Each sound ID: category (sfx | jingle | music | ambience), clips (several = variants, played round-robin; a clip is a path or { src, gainDb?, trim?: [startSec, endSec?], mix?: [paths layered on src], lowpassHz?, fadeOutSec? (with a [startSec, endSec] trim) }), volume (0..1, the SoundAsset volume), pitch ([min, max] PlaybackSpeed jitter), minInterval (seconds, overrides the code's default), gainDb (on top of the category's normalisation), confirmed (false until the owner picked it by ear), alternates (listed on the audition page), notes. "silent": true leaves the ID silent. After editing: npm run audio:lock, npm run audio:build, npm run audio:audition.

output.$comment: Vorbis at a fixed quality. Lossy encoding overshoots transients: a decoded sample peak above maxDecodedPeakDb is re-encoded with the gain lowered by the overshoot plus peakStepDb (at most peakPasses encodes).

limits.$comment: Roblox audio upload limits: under 20 MB, under 7 minutes, 48 kHz or lower.

silence.$comment: Silence trim (sfx and jingles): threshold, and how much silence to keep before the onset and after the end.

Silent until SR14's audition: sfx.breakable.break plays meanwhile (SFX_FALLBACK). 2026-11-13, owner's source pick: "Breaking Rock" by themightyglider, OpenGameArt, CC0 (rock_break.ogg: 0.44 s, 24 kHz stereo; derived from SoundCollectah's CC0 Freesound recording 109360), listed first: confirm it at the audition (move it into clips). sfx.silver.crate.notes: docs/SILVER.md SC3 / SV8: a barrel or crate holding Silver breaks (any source). A short, bright, SILVERY clink (thinner and glassier than gold): the cue mapper steps its pitch up for quick successive breaks (SILVER_CRATE_FX clink step, cap 6), so no pitch jitter here and a clean single hit is best. Must read apart from the gold coins (sfx.golden.hit Ninja Bonus/Coin.wav, Coin2 / Coin3, the Pixabay retro coin) and sfx.breakable.loot. Category sfx, SFX_PRIORITY 41. Silent until the audition: sfx.breakable.loot plays meanwhile (SFX_FALLBACK). Candidates sourced 2026-11-14, not auditioned: Kenney Interface Sounds glass_002 / glass_003 / glass_006 (CC0, 0.13 s, ~2 kHz glass pings), Little Robot Sound Factory Collect_Point_02 (CC-BY 3.0, already credited; 0.13 s, 8-bit ding), Kenney Impact Sounds impactGlass_light_000 (CC0; light_002 is taken).

sfx.silver.gain.notes: docs/SILVER.md SV8: the Silver counter ticks up for anything but a crate (+2 on a room clear, a floor, a boss, a vault, a secret, a Goldling). Small, soft and high: it plays often and under the room-clear and score sounds. Must read apart from sfx.score.tick and sfx.silver.crate. Category sfx, SFX_PRIORITY 44. Silent until the audition: sfx.score.tick plays meanwhile (SFX_FALLBACK). Candidates sourced 2026-11-14, not auditioned: Kenney Interface Sounds select_003 (0.18 s audible, 2.7 kHz), pluck_001 (0.07 s), glass_005 (0.05 s) (CC0); Little Robot Sound Factory Pickup_00 (CC-BY 3.0, already credited; 0.18 s).
